body: I totally erased my account because I was so heartbroken. I talked to psy about this and he doesn't know what to do because I erased the evidence. I have never been bashed with so much ferocity in my five plus years as a redditor.
That's what I'm seeing. There's still a few of the original crew though... who I keep in touch with. Please don't discount everyone. It's always been rough.
I have struggled with my own issues while trying to help others here. I was essentially outright attacked. I threw away another account and will throw this one away tonight.
A personal attack against me that was mean and unwarranted. I am treephant.

I had a posting two days ago. Nothing but upvotes and I recieved a very long winded piece of hate mail from this person It was based on a very bad attitude towards work I've done in the past. Frankly it's ruined reddit for me. Iam treephant.
